rationale.decision: Choose initial glucose loading for an equal-cost follow-up batch that better identifies uptake capacity after a low-loading calibration batch.
rationale.times: Biomass at 0.5, 1 and 2 hours probes early growth before depletion of the low-loading culture; 4.5 and 5 hours at flagship loading are withheld predictions. Window shortened after a runtime-only pilot, before inspecting follow-up outcomes; seeds and benefit thresholds unchanged.
rationale.noise: Illustrative independent Gaussian biomass assay SD 0.0001 gDW/L, as in the existing estimation demonstration; not published assay uncertainty.
rationale.volume: Declared constant density 1000 kg/m3; concentration uses sample-specific recorded mass. Initial total mass is preserved when loading changes.
rationale.confirmation: Five predeclared paired seeds, independent of baseline seed. The WP3 capability profile requires stable 1% predicted SD reduction against an extra baseline batch and all numerical gates. Lower aggregate withheld squared error is separately reported; the predictive-benefit profile additionally requires that observed comparison. A small synthetic demonstration, not statistical certification.
